items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: But they did say if you see any packages don’t open them. Well Dolores Hope gave everybody a Christmas gift and put packages in the rooms. So that was a funny thing. But that was before I got there.

ctx.x: Were there any train wrecks or memorable things that happened in Vietnam besides the heat. I would imagine the bugs you know if you’re playing like this?

Well there weren’t a lot of bugs that I remember but yeah we did have a couple of events. In fact the year before I joined, in 1968, the band used to stay in Saigon at the hotel there. And like I said, this was the year before I joined. But when the band was bussed over to the hotel just prior to getting there a Vietnamese put a bicycle, placed it in front of the hotel with explosives and blew up the side of the hotel. All the windows were smashed. Then the bus got through with the band and when they got in all…

rooms. So that was a funny thing. But that was before I got there. When I got there I remember we were in Da Nang performing. When we would land where the Freedom Hill was where they’d have 25,000 troops sitting up on the hill and they had a stage facing the hill. They’d bus us over to it, which was about a mile over to this hill, through a little village, a Vietnamese village. So there was a jeep in front of us with one of these machine guns in there and the guy’s standing up with a machine gun and a jeep behind…
